enrichments.summary: Reser's Fine Foods, Incl. is recalling its 5lb. Foodservice Tuna Salad products due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The contamination is linked to Newly Weds Foods Japanese Style Breadcrumbs, which were used in the tuna salad.
Reser's Raspberry Parfait Desserts, net wt. 8lb (2 packs per case), have been recalled due to spoilage resulting from temperature abuse caused by a malfunctioning refrigeration unit during transport.

Reser's Essential Everyday Original Potato Salad (16oz, refrigerated) is being recalled due to spoilage caused by temperature abuse during transport, resulting from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on trailer #184.

Reser's American Classics Spicy Pickle Potato Salad (16oz, UPC 71117 19084) has been recalled due to the potential presence of foreign material. The refrigerated product is packaged in an opaque printed plastic tub with a plastic red printed lid.
Reser's is recalling its Rotisserie Chicken Salad Base (2lb., UPC 71117 14743) due to the presence of foreign material.

Don Pancho Fiesta is recalling its 3 Pack Everything Sauce (Cilantro Lime Crema, Baja-Style Crema, Chipotle Crema) due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes, linked to recalled Cotija cheese used in ready-to-eat products.
key_entities: Don Pancho Fiesta 3 Pack Everything Sauce

enrichments.summary: Item 71117.14446, "Potatoes Creamy Deluxe Special Request," a refrigerated product, is being recalled due to potential spoilage caused by temperature abuse from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on a trailer.
Gravy Homestyle, a refrigerated product, is being recalled because it may become spoiled due to temperature abuse caused by a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on a trailer.

Sysco Corp is recalling its Imperial Deluxe Tuna Salad (Reorder #6526826, 5lb foodservice item) due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The contamination is linked to Newly Weds Foods recalled Japanese Style Breadcrumbs used in the tuna salad.

Aldi is recalling its Macaroni Salad because it was mislabeled with the ingredient statement for Coleslaw, resulting in undeclared wheat, a common allergen. The macaroni salad is sold in a 32oz clear square container.

Trader Joe's is recalling its Hot Honey Mustard Dressing due to the undeclared presence of peanuts, soy, sesame, and wheat, which are major food allergens. The mislabeling occurred because bottles intended for Hot Honey Mustard Dressing were filled with Thai Style Peanut Dressing.

Meal kits, specifically 'Home Chef Kit Street Taco Chicken With Tray', distributed by Fresh Creative Foods and Reser's Fine Foods Inc., were recalled due to the cooked chicken component being contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.

Chicken Street Taco Kits distributed by Fresh Creative Foods and Reser's Fine Foods, Inc. have been recalled due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes in the cooked chicken component of the meal kits.
Reser's American Classics Macaroni & Cheese is being recalled due to potential spoilage caused by temperature abuse from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit during transport.
HEB Poblano Caesar Dressing, 12oz glass bottles, is being recalled due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The contamination originated from repackaged Cotija cheese.

US Foods, Inc. is recalling Molly Kitchen's Tuna Salad due to mislabeling, where containers have Chicken Salad lids. This error results in undeclared fish allergen (tuna) in the product, posing a risk to individuals with fish allergies.
key_regulations: Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

enrichments.summary: HEB Cilantro Cotija Dressing Perfect for Tacos in 12oz glass bottles is being recalled due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes, which originated from repackaged Cotija cheese used in the product.

Fresh Creative Foods has recalled Item 406740, Asian Style Chicken Stir Fry Kit On Premise With Trays, due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes in the cooked chicken component of the meal kits.

A recall has been issued for 'Baked Scalloped Potatoes Special Request' (Item 71117.14378) due to spoilage caused by temperature abuse, which resulted from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on trailer #184.
Fresh Creative Foods is recalling Bistro 28 Chicken Quesadilla Express Meal Kits because they contain cooked chicken that was contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.

Molly's Kitchens Tuna Salad (item 794599, 5lb. Foodservice item) distributed by U.S. Foods, Inc. is recalled due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes, stemming from previously recalled Japanese Style Breadcrumbs from Newly Weds Foods.
Fresh Creative Foods has recalled Home Chef Asian Style Chicken Stir Fry meal kits due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes in the cooked chicken component.
Fresh Creative Foods has recalled its HMS Hatch Chicken Enchilada Kit due to the cooked chicken component being contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.

Multiple 'Cilantro Lime Crema' and 'Cilantro Lime Crema Everything Sauce' products, including those from FCF and Don Pancho, are being recalled due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The contamination originated from repackaged Cotija cheese.

Fresh Creative Foods (FCF) is recalling Smoked Mozzarella Penne Salad Kits (item #404284, UPC #13454 37904) due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The kit contains 2/3lbs. sealed bag of affected Penne Pasta and is a perishable/refrigerated product, not sold directly to consumers.
H-E-B is recalling Hill Country Fare Mustard Potato Salad due to the presence of plastic foreign material.
Reser's American Classics Garden Pasta Salad (16oz, UPC 71117 19063) is being recalled due to the presence of foreign material.
Reser's Kit HF Pudding Banana, a refrigerated product, is being recalled due to potential spoilage caused by temperature abuse from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on a trailer.
Fresh Creative Foods of Vista, CA, is recalling its Caesar Salad Kits (Item 401311, UPC 13454 35855) because they contain cooked chicken that was contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.

Bistro 28 Chicken Street Tacos Express Meal Kits, distributed by Fresh Creative Foods, Vista, CA, are being recalled due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes found in the cooked chicken component of the meal kits.
Reser's Sweet Corn with Butter is being recalled due to spoilage caused by temperature abuse during transport, resulting from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit.
Don Pancho Kit OP Street Taco Chicken NO Trays meal kits containing cooked chicken have been recalled due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.
The Beef & Lamb Gyro Sandwich Express Meal Kit, distributed by Fresh Creative Foods, has been recalled due to contamination with Salmonella, found in the cucumber ingredient of the tzatziki sauce.
Fresh Creative Foods is recalling Item 404884, Gyro Kit With Trays, due to Salmonella contamination originating from cucumber used in the tzatziki sauce.

Reser's American Classics Asiago Creamed Spinach is being recalled because the refrigerated product may become spoiled due to temperature abuse caused by a malfunctioning refrigeration unit during transport.
Stonemill Kitchens Green Goddess Pasta Salad is being recalled because it may become spoiled due to temperature abuse resulting from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on trailer #184.

Fresh Creative Foods has issued a recall for Item 404977, UPC 13454 38191, Green Chile Chicken Enchilada Kit O.P. No Trays 2/6.75 LB, due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes originating from the cooked chicken component of the meal kits.
Fresh Creative Foods is recalling Ginger Chicken Broccoli Salad Kit V due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes found in the cooked chicken component of the meal kits.

Sysco Corporation is recalling its Classic Tuna Salad (Reorder #6724249, net wt. 5lb) due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The contamination is linked to Newly Weds Foods Japanese Style Breadcrumbs used in the product. The tuna salad is a foodservice item packaged in a clear plastic tub.

Reser's Fine Foods has recalled Reser's Tuna Salad (5lb. Foodservice item) due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The contamination is linked to recalled Japanese Style Breadcrumbs used in the product.
Walmart Original Freshness Guaranteed Macaroni Salad is being recalled due to contamination with foreign material.
Walmart Original Freshness Guaranteed Macaroni Salad (16oz, refrigerated) with UPC 78742 12653 has been recalled due to the presence of foreign material.

Reser's Smokehouse Potato Salad (Item 71117.10923, net wt. 5lbs, 2 packs per case) is being recalled due to spoilage caused by temperature abuse resulting from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on trailer #184.
Fresh Creative Foods recalled Bistro 28 Chicken Burrito Bowl Express Meal Kits due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes in the cooked chicken component.

Fresh Creative Foods is recalling Gyro Kit No Trays (Item 404885) due to potential Salmonella contamination. The contamination is linked to cucumber found in the tzatziki sauce cups included in the kits, which are sold to consignees for further assembly or repackaging.

Signature Cafe Premium Tuna Salad (3lb/48oz) distributed by Lucerne Foods is recalled due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes, stemming from recalled Japanese Style Breadcrumbs supplied by Newly Weds Foods.

Reser's American Classics Macaroni & Cheese White Cheddar (12oz, refrigerated product) is being recalled due to potential spoilage caused by temperature abuse from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit during transport.
Reser's American Classics Scalloped Potatoes, 12oz refrigerated product, are being recalled due to spoilage caused by temperature abuse from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on a trailer.
Reser's Gourmet Tuna Salad is being recalled due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes, stemming from recalled Japanese Style Breadcrumbs supplied by Newly Weds Foods.

Reser's American Classics Egg Salad, a refrigerated product, is being recalled due to potential spoilage caused by temperature abuse, which resulted from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit on trailer #184.
A Premium Street Taco Kit containing cooked chicken was recalled due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.
Fresh Creative Foods is recalling 'Asian Style Stir Fry Single Serve OP no Trays' meal kits because they contain cooked chicken contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
Don Pancho Chicken Street Tacos Express Meal Kit is being recalled by Reser's Fine Foods Inc. due to contamination with Listeria monocytogenes found in the cooked chicken component of the meal kit.
Don Pancho Creamy Green Chile Chicken Enchilada Express Meal Kits were recalled due to the presence of Listeria monocytogenes contamination in the cooked chicken component of the meal kits.
Fresh Creative Foods (FCF) has recalled Basil Pesto Bowtie Pasta Kits and Salad Kits due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.

Multiple 'Chicken Street Taco' kits, including variants for express meals and single-serve options, have been recalled due to potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. The contamination originated from recalled Cotija cheese that was repackaged into these ready-to-eat taco products.
Amazon Fresh is recalling its Fresh Classic Macaroni Salad 16oz due to the potential presence of foreign material. The recalled product has UPC 95515 04502 and is packaged in a clear plastic tub.

Reser's Fine Foods has recalled its Amish Macaroni Salad because the product's side label, which was incorrectly printed as 'Reser's Southern Style with Egg Potato Salad,' failed to declare wheat, a known allergen, which is present in the Amish Macaroni Salad.

Don Pancho Chicken Quesadilla Express Meal Kits are being recalled because they contain cooked chicken that was contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
Fresh Creative Foods is recalling Bistro 28 Creamy Green Chile Chicken Enchilada Express Meal Kits due to a cooked chicken component being contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
